name: Magnamon (X Antibody)
main_effect:
[Opponent's Turn] When an opponent's Digimon attacks, if a card with the [Armor Form] trait or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, you may switch the target of an attack to this Digimon.
[All Turns] When this Digimon would be deleted, you may place the top card of this Digimon on top of your security stack face down to prevent that deletion.
